title: A merge that changes the page code republishes the page
why:

Two done steps were meant to stop this. c130's republish is a prose step for the batch runner, and batch 122 skipped it. page-stale-hook reads a stamp at <git common dir>/waiting-page-built (stale_pages.py read_stamp) and stays silent with no stamp, so in a fresh cloud container it likely never fires (retrospective's code reading, not probed). The Status tab also lags: nothing republishes it after each batch.
